parameters.query:
WITH approved AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sds_code_id)
    sds_code_id, input_content, item_content, updated_at,
    tp.status_id, input_source_id, code_label,
    'approved' as row_type
  FROM ai_treatment_plan_items tp
  LEFT JOIN sds_codes sc ON sds_code_id = sc.id
  WHERE ai_treatment_plan_id = {{ $('Get Treatment Plan ID').item.json.get_or_create_ai_treatment_plan_id }}
    AND tp.status_id IN (254183, 254184)
  ORDER BY sds_code_id, tp.updated_at DESC
),
pending AS (
  SELECT 
    tp.sds_code_id, tp.input_content, tp.item_content, tp.updated_at,
    tp.status_id, tp.input_source_id, sc.code_label,
    'pending' as row_type
  FROM ai_treatment_plan_items tp
  LEFT JOIN sds_codes sc ON sds_code_id = sc.id
  WHERE ai_treatment_plan_id = {{ $('Get Treatment Plan ID').item.json.get_or_create_ai_treatment_plan_id }}
    AND (tp.status_id = 254182 OR tp.status_id IS NULL)
    AND tp.updated_at > COALESCE(
      (SELECT MAX(a.updated_at) FROM approved a WHERE a.sds_code_id = tp.sds_code_id),
      '1970-01-01'
    )
)
SELECT * FROM approved
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM pending
ORDER BY sds_code_id, updated_at DESC
